title: Chapter 112 The Lords' Sighs
content:
Chapter 112 The Lords' Sighs

Iron Blood City.

Liu Hong, the Iron Blood Lord, looked at the battle of Toad Brunei in the light screen in front of him, and a smile appeared in his eyes.

He opened his mouth gracefully, and the maid next to him immediately presented a crystal clear grape.

"Lord Sunset, don't you want to recruit these high-quality players?" He laughed, and the smile on his face disappeared in an instant, and snorted coldly, "Then I will destroy them one by one."

After saying that, he spit out the grape seeds in his mouth, and a guard standing guard at the door in the distance was directly killed.

The maids next to him, although frightened, had to pretend that nothing had happened.

After all, this kind of thing is not the first time it has happened.

Qingyang Mansion.

Dongfang Ke, the Lord of Qingyang, just saw the scene of his daughter being "killed" through the screen.

Boundless anger rose in his heart, although he saw the scene of Dongfang Ling turning into fluorescent light and disappearing, he knew that his daughter was not dead.

Instead, she escaped this disaster through the scapegoat.

However, daring to attack his own daughter is simply an unforgivable crime.

"Come here!" He angrily crushed a small walnut in his hand.

"Lord!"

The guard outside the door immediately walked in and saluted him.

"Go and call General Manager Fang immediately. I want to crush the Toad Clan."

Sunset City.

On the throne, Wang Zhu, the Lord of Sunset City, also had a gloomy face.

Wang Shuo was originally a target he was optimistic about recruiting, not only because of his outstanding performance in the novice trial.

More importantly, he was brave and resourceful, and knew how to make choices. As long as he could survive the chaotic period of the village construction order, he would definitely have a place in the future.

"What a pity!" He sighed silently.

Due to the battle in Wana Village, the scale of the battle for the village construction order was unprecedented.

Tens of millions of wild beasts besieged a village, and there was even a group of bosses.

This kind of formation was unprecedented.

So it attracted countless lords from outside the domain to watch.

Most of the lords sighed at this time!

Just when everyone was not optimistic about Wang Shuo.

Just when Gong Zheng was at his wit's end.

Just when everyone in Wana Village had lost hope.

Wang Shuo finally made a difficult decision.

Wang Shuo struggled to stand up and said to Gong Zheng indifferently: "You have tried your best. Next, leave it to me!"

"Lord!"

Gong Zheng's heart tightened, and he couldn't think of what Wang Shuo could do.

"No need to say more, I have my own plan." Wang Shuo shook his head and said in a low voice.

He looked up at Toad Brunei.

Wang Shuo said loudly: "Brunei, you and I have no grudges, why do you force each other so hard?"

Brunei also stopped attacking.

"Jie, Jie." He laughed strangely.

This strange laugh sounded like the howling of ghosts and wolves, and the huge airflow caused sand and rocks to fly in front of him, making a mess.

"Do you think you are qualified to talk to me?"

"Did the stone man just now give you the courage?"

"Hahahaha..."

"I just haven't found such an interesting toy for a long time, and I want to play with it for a while."

"You ants are just food in my mouth."

"Does food have the right to question predators?"

"Haha..."

Perhaps, he hasn't talked properly for a long time, and he yawned after he finished speaking.

After hearing this, Wang Shuo was so angry that his face turned blue and his heart was furious.

This is really, a toad yawning - a big tone.

"I just want to die with a clear mind before I die." Wang Shuo suppressed his anger and wanted to get some words out.

He also felt that the beast that attacked Wana Village this time was wrong.

There must be something wrong, a big problem.

It may even be a conspiracy.
